title: 300: An ACA 870 μm Continuum Survey of Orion Protostars and Their Evolution
question: Characterize the evolution of protostellar envelopes and test whether the ALMA 12 m to ACA 870 μm continuum flux ratio serves as an evolutionary indicator that avoids inclination and foreground extinction degeneracies affecting SED-based classifications.

recipe.goal: Create 870 μm continuum maps and measure image noise (I_nu rms and F_nu rms)
recipe.method: Clean combined continuum windows with tclean using Briggs robust=0.5 and automasking. Measure I_nu rms as the mean rms in three off-source 6" radius circular apertures. Measure integrated F_nu rms using sixteen 6" radius circular apertures in a ring on the residual image with iterative 2-sigma clipping.
key_parameters: robust = 0.5, pixel size = 0.55", aperture radius = 6", iterative 2-sigma rejection for F_nu rms

recipe.goal: Determine source centroids and classify ACA envelope morphologies
recipe.method: Find emission centroid using photutils centroid_quadratic (fallback to centroid_2dg, then manual selection). Compare the area of the half-maximum contour of the central 9x9 pixels to the restoring beam area, and check if the 12 m disk position falls inside the contour or if multiple peaks share a contour.
key_parameters: Area ratio < 1.3: unresolved; 1.3 to 2.4: compact; > 2.4: extended; shared continuous half-max contour: multiple; 12 m disk outside half-max contour: offset

recipe.goal: Measure ACA 870 μm continuum flux densities
recipe.method: Measure flux in three ways: beam flux at peak pixel in central 9x9 pixels, beam flux at 12 m disk position, and integrated flux using photutils aperture_photometry within a 6" radius circle convolved with the beam FWHM. Adopt convolved aperture flux for non-offset sources and beam flux at 12 m disk position for offset sources. Apply 5-sigma upper limits for non-detections.
key_parameters: 6" (~2500 au) aperture radius convolved with beam FWHM; 5-sigma detection threshold
assumptions: Average distance to Orion of 400 pc (6" corresponds to ~2500 au)

recipe.goal: Calculate 12 m/ACA flux ratios (R), envelope fluxes, and statistical comparisons across SED classes
recipe.method: Calculate R = F_nu(12 m) / F_nu(ACA) and envelope flux = F_nu(ACA) - F_nu(12 m), summing 12 m disk fluxes when multiple 12 m sources fall within the ACA half-max contour. Perform Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S), Anderson-Darling (A-D), Spearman rank, and Kendall's Tau tests across SED classes and T_bol.
key_parameters: R = 0.5 threshold separating envelope-dominated (R < 0.5) from disk-dominated (R > 0.5) sources
assumptions: 12 m flux traces the disk while ACA flux traces combined disk plus inner envelope

recipe.goal: Estimate envelope masses, mass infall rates, and fraction of stellar mass accreted as a function of R
recipe.method: Convert envelope flux (ACA - 12 m difference) to envelope mass M_ACA using Eq. (2), compute freefall time t_ff via Eq. (3), and estimate infall rate M_dot = M_env / t_ff. Fit a 4th-degree polynomial to log10(M_dot) vs. R and a power law to cumulative N_proto vs. R using scipy.optimize.curve_fit, then integrate Eq. (7) to get fraction of mass accreted f_acc(R).
key_parameters: R bin width = 0.0055 for median infall rate fit
assumptions: Distance D = 400 pc, dust temperature T = 15 K, dust opacity = 2.57 cm^2 g^-1 at 700 μm scaled to 870 μm with beta = 1.8, dust-to-gas ratio = 0.01
Spherically symmetric freefall with total mass M = 0.25 M_sun, outer envelope radius r_outer = 2500 au, constant star formation rate, and protostellar lifetime of 500,000 yr
